mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >50% of FEDFUNDS<0.5% periods or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as investors flee risk.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >50% of UNRATE rise>0.5pp instances or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in real consumer spending (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 3-month moving averages signal economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO both above 3-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >50% of joint RSAFS/INDPRO above MA instances or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS >4.5% and rising), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >50% of FEDFUNDS>4.5% and rising periods or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month average industrial production decline below 90% signals severe manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >50% of INDPRO<90% of 12-month average instances or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 450,000 units (10% drop from prior 3 months) signals weak consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >50% of HOUST<450,000 instances or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate rise (>0.3pp) and federal funds rate decline (>0.1pp) in 3 months signal recession with policy response, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >50% of joint UNRATE rise/FEDFUNDS fall instances or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market recovery (UNRATE falling below 8.0% and PAYEMS rising >50,000), improving employment conditions drive positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8.0% and PAYEMS rises > 50,000 in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >50% of joint UNRATE fall/PAYEMS rise instances or Rank IC <0.03.
